newsitem.title: PERU: Peru hostages to be freed Dec. 24 - radio report.
newsitem.headline: Peru hostages to be freed Dec. 24 - radio report.

text.p: A caller from the besieged Japanese embassy residence identifying himself as Comandante Evaristo told Peruvian radio that all the hostages in the crisis would be set free on December 24.

There was no way to immediately verify the information but the Radio Programas del Peru radio station told listeners that the caller was the same person who had spoken earlier to them from the inside of the embassy residence.
"On the 24th at 10 at night absolutely all the hostages will be freed", the caller said, speaking live on air.
The call took Peru totally by surprise as no breakthrough in the four-day-old crisis seemed imminent.
